newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the panhandle area Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers were $2.00 higher, USDA said.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 46,700 slaughter steers and 28,400 heifers; 108,900 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 32,300 formulated and 1,100 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 66.00; Carcass Basis 105.00-105.50. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00-65.00.
Pen Select and Choice 1-3 1350 lb Holsteins 58.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 66.00, pen North Plains 66.50; Carcass Basis 105.00-105.50. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00-65.50.
Note all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed: 75,100 Week Ago: None Year Ago: 300
Wk to Date: 108,900 Week Ago: 50,100 Year Ago: 36,700
